description: Source code for Vulkan format utilities in ANGLE project, including format support checks, format initialization, swizzle mapping, and format capabilities.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents Vulkan format details, including format IDs, Vulkan formats, and support info.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Manages a collection of formats, initializes format data, and provides support checks.

methods.name: FillTextureFormatCaps
methods.description: Populates texture capabilities based on renderer and format support.

methods.name: HasFullBufferFormatSupport
methods.description: Checks if a buffer format has full support.

methods.name: FindSupportedFormat
methods.description: Finds the first supported format from a list based on a support test.

methods.name: Format::initImageFallback
methods.description: Initializes image format fallback based on support.

methods.name: Format::initBufferFallback
methods.description: Initializes buffer format fallback based on support.

methods.name: Format::hasEmulatedImageChannels
methods.description: Checks if the format emulates image channels.

methods.name: FormatTable::initialize
methods.description: Initializes format data and populates texture capabilities and compressed formats.

methods.name: GetMaximalImageUsageFlags
methods.description: Returns maximal image usage flags supported for a format.

methods.name: GetVertexInputAlignment
methods.description: Calculates vertex input alignment based on format.

methods.name: MapSwizzleState
methods.description: Maps internal swizzle state based on format and context.

methods.name: ComposeSwizzleState
methods.description: Combines two swizzle states into one.
